title: Chomp turn result
description: The fenced json block every agent turn ends with. Validated by harness/runner/turn-result.mjs; the runner turns it into card state and chat messages.

status.description: answered: the owner only asked or chatted; the agent replied and changed nothing, so the card stays as it was.

summary.description: The agent's chat message to the owner, in Markdown: second person to them, first person about itself.

blocker.description: Required when status is blocked: what would unblock the agent.

figma_nodes.description: Designer: ids of the sections/frames it created or changed on the task's Figma page. The runner's DS lint judges only these.
